**[7]** "Gaze." *unboundforce.dev*, 2026.
<https://unboundforce.dev/docs/projects/gaze/>
**Tier:** 2
Gaze architecture: side effect detection across P0-P4 tiers. P0-P2 effects
(implemented): return values, error returns, state mutations, I/O operations,
channel sends, file system operations, database writes, goroutine spawns,
panics, context cancellation. P3-P4 (not yet detected): stdout/stderr, env
mutations, mutex, reflection, unsafe pointers. Three metrics (Contract
Coverage, Over-Specification Score, GazeCRAP), GazeCRAP formula: complexity²
× (1 - contractCoverage)³ + complexity, assertion mapping accuracy ~84.7%,
fix strategy labels (add_tests/add_assertions/decompose/decompose_and_test).
